_readme: Starter profile for a brand-new portfolio. `npm run init` copies this to profile.json and starter/my-cv.pdf + starter/my-photo.png into assets/. Replace every placeholder with something true about you; the build warns while placeholder markers remain. Full field reference: schema.md. A fully-worked real example: examples/ankush-profile.json.
